subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair or adopt the conflicting fork PR, or open a fresh narrow target-repo fix for this Feishu reply-mention bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but the only exact open candidate is outside the target repo, conflicting, and previously reviewed as needing safer mention and root-routing behavior.

options.title: Replace with a current-main fix
options.body: Use the existing PRs as context but land a target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence, routing tests, and Feishu proof.

options.title: Ask the fork author to repair
options.body: Keep this issue open while requesting a rebase, proof, and fixes for the prior routing and mention-gating concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known bug without starting another repair lane until Feishu maintenance bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Replace with a current-main fix
recommendation.body: Use the existing PRs as context but land a target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence, routing tests, and Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-handling and reply-dispatcher work makes this the closest routing candidate for deciding the safe fix shape.
